'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that the [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]] will be extended so that [[Iran]] can make a "unified proposal", upon [[Pakistan]]i [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] and [[Field Marshal (Pakistan)|field marshal]] [[Asim Munir]]'s request. However, Trump also says the [[Naval blockade of Iran|blockade]] will remain. ***[[Naval blockade of Iran]]
****The [[United States Indo-Pacific Command|U.S. Indo-Pacific Command]] announces that it stopped and boarded a stateless [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]], M/T ''Tifani'', which it says is connected to Iran. [https://www.stripes.com/theaters/middle_east/2026-04-21/oil-iran-tanker-navy-blockade-pacific-21441869.html (''Stars and Stripes'')]
****[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] calls the blockade "an act of war" and a violation of the [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]]. [https://aje.news/0v16yj?update=4510957 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[Hezbollah]] fires rockets at [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] in [[southern Lebanon]] and launches a drone into [[northern Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-says-hezbollah-breached-truce-launching-rockets-at-troops-drone-at-israel/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****Two [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are sentenced to 30 days in [[military prison]] for destroying a statue of [[Jesus]] with a [[sledgehammer]] in the [[Christianity in Lebanon|Christian]] village of [[Debel, Lebanon|Debel]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/apr/21/two-israeli-soldiers-jailed-over-smashing-of-jesus-statue-in-lebanon-village (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/2-troops-dismissed-jailed-for-smashing-statue-of-jesus-in-southern-lebanon/amp/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]], [[France–Lebanon relations]]
****[[President of France|French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] affirms [[France]]'s support for the [[territorial integrity]] of Lebanon, saying that the withdrawal of Israeli troops from the country is a precondition for stability. [https://aje.news/0v16yj?update=4510852 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Israeli settler violence]]
****Two Palestinians are killed and three are injured in an attack towards a school by [[Israeli Settlers|settlers]] and Israeli soldiers in [[Al-Mughayyir, Ramallah|Al-Mughayyir]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/two-palestinians-killed-west-bank-village-by-israeli-settlers-witnesses-say-2026-04-21/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
***Israeli troops raid the [[Quneitra Governorate]] in [[Syria]], where they detain three people. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-forces-raid-syria-s-quneitra-countryside-open-fire/3913968 (AA)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Libya–Sudan relations]]
***A [[United Nations]] investigation finds that the [[Libyan National Army]] (LNA) led by [[Khalifa Haftar]] facilitated the [[Arms trafficking|transfer of weapons]], vehicles and [[Colombia]]n [[mercenary|mercenaries]] to [[Sudan]] to fight for the [[Rapid Support Forces]] against [[Sudanese Armed Forces|government forces]]. The operation was centred around [[Kufra]], Libya, where LNA forces control [[Kufra Airport]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-military-rsf-libya-uae-d6dea5d3d58c99bdf9c30d4554e24508 (AP)]
**[[Transitional Sovereignty Council]] leader [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] and [[Oman]]i [[Sultan of Oman|sultan]] [[Haitham bin Tariq]] hold official talks to focus on regional development and efforts to end the war in Sudan. [https://www.muscatdaily.com/2026/04/21/burhan-thanks-omans-efforts-for-peace-in-sudan/ (''Muscat Daily'')]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Russia]]n [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|defence ministry]] says the [[Africa Corps (Russia)|Africa Corps]] freed a [[Russians|Russian]] and a [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] citizen abducted in [[Niger]] in July 2024 by [[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] during an operation conducted in [[Mali]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-africa-corps-niger-abducted-jnim-ukrainian-5a40e762d047e0f9e7de1c8ccdd1bc6c (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Nepal]] resumes issuing [[work permit]]s for [[Nepalese diaspora|its nationals]] seeking [[Migrant workers in the Gulf Cooperation Council region|employment]] in the [[Middle East]] after a temporary suspension linked to the [[2026 Iran war|Iran war]], citing guidance from [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Nepal)|the foreign ministry]] and demand from workers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nepal-resumes-issuing-permits-workers-headed-middle-east-2026-04-21/ (Reuters)]
**[[Vitol]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Russell Hardy]] says that at least one billion [[Barrel (unit)|barrels]] of [[oil]] production will be lost because of the war even if it ends immediately, and that the current loss is in the range of 600 to 700 million barrels. [https://www.ft.com/content/68c80b3e-b645-46a5-b748-0d2ebb3f56e7?syn-25a6b1a6=1 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Defense industry of Japan]]
**[[Japan]] approves new rules easing long-standing restrictions on [[arms exports]], allowing the overseas transfer of a broader range of defense equipment, including [[deadly weapon]]s. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/04/22/world/asia-oceania/japan-overhauls-decades-old-weapons-export-rules/2325133 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cross-strait relations]], [[Eswatini–Taiwan relations]]
**[[Taiwan]]ese [[President of the Republic of China|president]] [[Lai Ching-te]] cancels [[List of international presidential trips made by Lai Ching-te|his planned visit]] to [[Eswatini]] after the governments of [[Madagascar]], [[Mauritius]], and [[Seychelles]] denied [[Flight permit|overflight permissions]] for [[Air Force 3701|his aircraft]], with Taiwan attributing the decision to pressure from [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/taiwan-president-cancels-eswatini-trip-blames-chinese-pressure-african-countries-2026-04-21/ (Reuters)]

[https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-druzhba-pipeline-7dfc9574bf95a69eda13b1440171e402 (AP)]
* [[Visit by Pope Leo XIV to Algeria, Cameroon, Angola, and Equatorial Guinea]]
** [[Pope Leo XIV]] arrives in [[Malabo]], the final leg of his [[papal visit]] to [[Africa]], becoming the first pope to visit [[Equatorial Guinea]] since [[Pope John Paul II|John Paul II]] [[List of pastoral visits of Pope John Paul II#1980s|in 1982]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-pope-equatorial-guinea-0134a6982c295c125259c5fa4eb73395 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Indonesian protests]]
**A joint investigation by the [[Indonesia]]n [[National Commission on Human Rights|human rights commission]], the [[ombudsman]], and the child protection commission finds that [[Indonesian National Police|police]] and other [[Law enforcement in Indonesia|state security]] personnel violated [[Human rights in Indonesia|human rights]], including [[Arbitrary arrest and detention|arbitrary arrests]], torture, and alleged [[child sexual abuse]], during anti-[[Red and White Cabinet|government]] protests in 2025 that left at least 11 people dead and thousands detained. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-rights-bodies-find-widespread-abuses-2025-protests-2026-04-21/ (Reuters)]
*At least five people are killed and 200 others are injured in a [[prison riot]] at the [[Yare Prison]] in [[Miranda State]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2026/04/1423400/venezuela-prison-riot-leaves-five-dead (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
*[[South Korea]]n [[Law enforcement in South Korea|police]] seek an [[arrest warrant]] for [[Hybe]] founder and chairperson [[Bang Si-hyuk]] over alleged violations of [[capital market]] laws related to Hybe's [[initial public offering]], accusing him of misleading early investors and receiving profits through a related [[private equity fund]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-police-seek-detention-warrant-hybe-chairman-yonhap-says-2026-04-21/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-bang-hybe-arrest-bts-00e181bfbe471c541118d67f7ccad7bd (AP News)]
*The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. justice department]] indicts the [[Southern Poverty Law Center]] on [[fraud]] charges related to payments it made to infiltrate [[White supremacy in the United States|white supremacist]] [[hate group]]s, including the [[Ku Klux Klan]], [[Aryan Nations]] and the [[American Nazi Party]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/apr/21/doj-southern-poverty-law-center-investigation (''The Guardian'')] [https://nypost.com/2026/04/21/us-news/doj-charges-southern-poverty-law-center-with-fraud-for-paying-white-supremacist-groups-3m-to-stoke-racial-hatred/ (''New York Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Corruption in the United States]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] member [[Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick]] resigns from her position amid a probe by the [[United States House Committee on Ethics|House Ethics Committee]], following her November 2025 indictment by federal prosecutors for stealing $5 million of [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] relief funds, some of which allegedly went towards funding her [[2022 Florida's 20th congressional district special election|2022 election campaign]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3350930/cherfilus-mccormick-third-lawmaker-quit-wave-scandal-swamps-us-congress (AFP via ''SCMP'')] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/21/sheila-cherfilus-mccormick-resigns-congress.html (CNBC)]
*[[Smoking in the United Kingdom]]
**The [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|British parliament]] passes the [[Tobacco and Vapes Bill]] formally banning anyone in [[England]] born after December 31, 2008, from buying [[cigarette]]s and other [[tobacco]] products in an effort to create a "smoke-free generation". The age controls will enter force on January 1, 2027. [https://apnews.com/article/uk-smoking-ban-vape-vaping-cigarettes-ade338fc91f6a7dc73d4996acb64ca5d (AP)]
*The [[House of Representatives (Indonesia)|Indonesian parliament]] passes the landmark Domestic Workers Protection Bill into [[Law of Indonesia|law]] after 22 years of deliberation. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-21/indonesia-passes-law-to-protect-millions-of-domestic-workers (Bloomberg)]
*[[New Zealand]] [[Prime Minister of New Zealand|prime minister]] [[Christopher Luxon]] secures the support of [[Sixth National Government of New Zealand|his caucus]] after initiating and winning a [[confidence vote]] on his leadership within the [[New Zealand National Party|National Party]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-pm-luxon-says-he-has-support-lawmakers-2026-04-21/ (Reuters)]

** [[NASA]] announces that the ''[[Curiosity (rover)|Curiosity]]'' [[Mars rover|rover]] has detected more than 20 [[organic molecules]] on [[Mars]] using a [[chemical analysis]] method involving [[tetramethylammonium hydroxide]], conducted for the first time on another planet, indicating the long-term preservation of compounds associated with [[prebiotic chemistry]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/04/22/world/americas-emea/rover-finds-more-building-blocks-of-life-on-mars/2325021 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
